artifact.name: GLM-5.2 Neimeng B300 cache-aware prefill stable MFU and kernel timeline
artifact.run_shape: standalone SGLang TP=1 DP=1 PP=4, max_tokens=1, continuous agent sessions, 300s admission plus full drain

profile_start_note: t=0 is Nsight TARGET_INFO_SESSION_START_TIME; client and CRI-shaped exec-stream timestamps are aligned to its UTC epoch.

collection.boundary_semantics: externally recorded return from nsys start; earlier timeline region is uncollected, not measured zero

nccl_comm.interpretation: Aggregate communication/synchronization kernel residency; not useful model compute and not wall time.

coverage.reason: The exec-launched server stream was wrapped as RFC3339 nanoseconds plus `stdout F` from before readiness through the completion gate.

completion_contract.post_run_decode_gauge_note: The decode_sum_seq_lens gauge remains stale at up to 13 after startup/warmup. Measured-window raw logs contain zero Decode batch rows and every running/queue gauge is zero.

latency_breakdown.timer_semantics: Client timer starts immediately before aiohttp ClientSession.post; it includes connection-pool wait, server queue/prefill, and response delivery.

matching.method: Exact prompt/cached/completion-token signature, then completion order within duplicate signatures

latency_breakdown.interpretation: This is saturated-load client-observed latency, not unloaded model TTFT. With max_tokens=1, server receive-to-finish is effectively the queued one-token prefill completion interval, and measured decode rows are zero.

contract.peak_source: NVIDIA HGX B300 official dense FP4 specification
contract.logical_work: For request i, W_i = F(prompt_i) - F(cached_prefix_i), with the final LM head included once. Cached-prefix model work is excluded; new suffix queries still attend over their full causal context.
contract.precision_aware_work: The primary numerator is trace-anchored dense-FP4-equivalent Tensor-Core model math: routed NVFP4 x1, FP8 indexer/MLA x3, and BF16 attention/shared-expert GEMMs x6. Scalar, SFU, vector, dense-MLP, router, indexer-setup, absorbed-transform, and LM-head work is reported as unconverted and excluded.
contract.stable_allocation: Scale scheduler PP0 new-token work to remove page padding, then multiply by the context-aware FP4-equivalent FLOPs/new-token ratio of requests completing in the stable interval.

stable.reference_rate_method: median PP0 new-token rate across 15-second windows that remain above the queue floor and contain at least one scheduler row from every PP stage
stable.method: longest interval whose trailing 15-second PP0 new-token rate stays within 10% of the median among qualifying 15-second windows, every window contains work from all four PP stages, and queue depth stays above 10% of issued requests (minimum 16) throughout every window

completion_gate.decode_gauge_note: The decode_sum_seq_lens gauge remains stale at up to 13 after startup/warmup. Measured-window raw logs contain zero Decode batch rows and every running/queue gauge is zero.

nccl_sendrecv.interpretation: Long-lived PP SendRecv communication/synchronization residency; not equivalent to useful model compute or wall time.

scheduler_log_coverage.reason: The exec-launched server stream was wrapped as RFC3339 nanoseconds plus `stdout F` from before readiness through the completion gate.

latency_matching.method: Exact prompt/cached/completion-token signature, then completion order within duplicate signatures

limitations: Standalone prefill-shaped run, not real disaggregated PD KV transfer.
Dynamo registration and Mooncake transport flags are omitted from the one-node endpoint.
User, workspace, and growing-session prefixes intentionally make cache reuse part of throughput.
MFU excludes cached-prefix model work but includes new-suffix attention over the full cached context.
